record_title: Sharp condition-number threshold for monotone exact-CG residuals
scientific_context: For exact CG on a finite-dimensional SPD matrix, the sharp worst-case ratio of successive Euclidean residual norms is (kappa-1)/(2 sqrt(kappa)); therefore all residual steps are nonincreasing for every right-hand side and initial guess exactly when kappa_2(A) <= 3+2 sqrt(2). A direction-history refinement and the corresponding fixed-preconditioner statement in the M^{-1} residual norm are also proved.
limitations: Exact arithmetic and finite-dimensional real SPD matrices only. The PCG extension is in the M^{-1} residual norm, not the Euclidean residual norm. The condition-number statement is uniform over all right-hand sides and initial guesses and is not necessary for a particular run. No floating-point residual-gap, A-norm error, iteration-complexity, or performance claim is made. Meurant's exact-arithmetic chapter and the relevant Liesen-Strakos monograph treatment were not available in complete theorem-level form for inspection, leaving residual historical prior-coverage risk.

artifact_inventory.description: Deterministic NumPy verification of the sharp endpoint construction, the threshold, and the global and history-aware residual bounds on SPD examples.
Deterministic output of the numerical verification.
